department: J. Mike Walker '66 Department of Mechanical Engineering

deadline.value: December 15 for funding priority; February 1 is the final fall deadline.
deadline.quote: December 15 for Fall admission funding priority | February 1 for Fall admission final application deadline

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Research assistantships are awarded directly by faculty, so contact faculty whose research matches yours.
supervisor.quote: If you are interested in pursuing a GAR position, reach out to faculty whose research aligns with your interests to see what opportunities may be available in their labs.

funding.value: Research assistantships come from individual faculty and teaching assistantships are limited; both pay a salary, insurance and tuition/fees.
funding.quote: These positions are awarded directly to the students by the faculty. | Our department has a limited number of Graduate Assistant – Teaching (GAT) positions available each semester.

entry_route.value: The pages checked do not say whether a master's is needed.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay $148: the $90 Texas A&M fee plus the $58 EngineeringCAS fee.
app_fee.quote: International Applicants: $148 - Texas A&M University fee ($90) + EngineeringCAS Processing Fee ($58)

gre_general.value: GRE is not required, but submitted scores are considered.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required. However, if a student has GRE scores and wants to include them in their application, the scores will be considered in the review process.

notes: Applications via EngineeringCAS. Includes aerospace-adjacent research; Aerospace Engineering is a separate TAMU department not researched here.
